map_info.name: Entropy Workshop
map_info.title: What the gauge forgets
map_info.description: Change an arrangement, preserve a consequence and examine what the chosen measure misses.

learning_objectives: Sort the same sample and distinguish changed arrangement from unchanged counts and entropy
Calculate marginal Shannon entropy from symbol shares and name its units and alphabet ceiling
Compare observed counts with the active source probabilities in two cached samples
Inspect relative histogram scaling, zero-count marks and the neighbours omitted by the measurement
Compare marginal Shannon colour entropy with Boltzmann configurational entropy for a specified sixteen-site occupancy model; preserve and replay its trajectory

documentation.layout: Two 25 m wide bays. Museum arrival at (8,2), grid entrance at (8,0). Counting and mixing precede arrangements; the point enclosure and physical ruin have separate floor areas. A 3 m doorway at z33 leads to the signal room and exit. Hybrid and wear studies are optional side encounters.
